verses.text: The idols Bel and Nebo bow down low. They are carried away by animals and cattle. The idols you used to carry around are now heavy loads, a burden for tired animals.
Together they bend low and bow down. They cannot save the load. Instead, they themselves are carried off into captivity.
"Listen to me, people of Jacob, all you who are left of the people of Israel. I have carried you since you were born. I have taken care of you since you were in the womb.
Even when you are old, I will be the same. Even when your hair is gray, I will carry you. I made you, and I will carry you. I will hold you up and rescue you.
Who will you compare me to? Who will you say is my equal? Who will you compare me with, as if we were the same?
Some people pour gold out of their bags and weigh out silver on scales. They hire a goldsmith to make it into a god. Then they bow down and worship it!

They lift it onto their shoulders and carry it. They set it in its place, and there it stands. It cannot move from its spot. Even when someone cries out to it, it cannot answer. It cannot save them from their trouble.
Remember this and stand firm. Think about it again, you rebels.
Remember the things I did long ago. For I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is no one like me.
I tell the end from the beginning, and from long ago I tell what is still to come. I say, 'My plan will stand, and I will do everything I want.'
I call a bird of prey from the east, a man from a faraway land to carry out my plan. What I have said, I will make happen. What I have planned, I will do.
Listen to me, you stubborn people, you who are far from doing what is right.
I am bringing my righteousness near. It is not far away, and my salvation will not be late. I will give salvation to Zion and my glory to Israel."
